config.welcomeMessage: Welcome to the Ambedkar Digital Heritage Museum. Explore historical documents, speeches, photographs, constitutional materials and archival records.

records.title: [SAMPLE] Sample Manuscript Record
records.description: A placeholder manuscript record used for offline demo mode. Real institutional scans and OCR text will be supplied by the archive backend.

records.title: [SAMPLE] Sample Digitized Document
records.description: A placeholder document whose OCR-extracted text will be searchable once the OCR pipeline is connected. This entry only proves the data path works.

records.title: [SAMPLE] Sample Photograph Record
records.description: Placeholder record for a scanned photograph. The archive stores the original file, metadata, and a stable document id.

records.title: [SAMPLE] Sample Speech Record
records.description: Placeholder record for an audio speech. Audio narration and text-to-speech are wired in later phases.

records.title: [SAMPLE] Sample Timeline Event
records.description: Placeholder timeline event demonstrating how the 3D timeline will load configurable events from data instead of being hard-coded.
